seed.question: What was Discover’s ROE for 2023 compared to 2022?
seed.ground_truth_answer:
Discover Financial Services: Return on Equity (ROE) for 2023 vs. 2022
ROE Calculation: Formula: ROE=Net Income allocated to Common Shareholders/Average Shareholders’ Equity
Net Income allocated to common shareholders:
2023: $2,859 million
2022: $4,286 million
Average Shareholders’ Equity=(Equity (2023)+Equity (2022))/2=($14,828 million+$14,344 million)/2=$14,586 million
ROE Calculation:
2023: ROE (2023)=$2,859 million/$14,586 million = 19.6%
2022: ROE (2022)=$4,286 million/$14,344 million = 29.9%
